name: Ocean Shine
source:
This is a story about childhood friends whose lives are filled with different events, pleasant and unpleasant. Whether together or apart, they face the past, the present, and the future. 

[Translated from [url=https://otovn.itch.io/ocean-shine]itch.io[/url]]
